decision: Approve the staged F3 batch emission and hardened approve/reject/close-children workflow rollout, or keep legacy fanout?
whyItMatters: Merging engineering must not silently change the daily issue queue or activate new event-driven write semantics.
evidence: Issue #2131 explicitly requests founder-compatible F3 amendment review. Earlier campaign prose inferred approval from a brief; this mission does not ratify that inference.
The daily cron remains 0 6 * * *; CLI and workflow defaults are fanout. New event jobs and manual batch writes are staged behind STEWARD_ISSUE_HYGIENE_V2, which this work does not set.
PR #2133 comment 6344218194 records the canonical open-issue-per-suite correction. It is retained as evidence, not a ruling on rollout or closed-history suppression.

Founder final rulings, 2026-11-06, relayed to the Steward owner (Opus) for #2283 (verbatim): "Honestly I'm fine with this already, but yes if there is a better way to keep "issue noise" really low, I'm up for that. Before, this wasn't a problem since skill owners don't really update their skills often. Now its like everyday they do this, yet I only do a steward run one B class a day or a batch a week. I would really like batching."

Ruling as applied: Approved: staged batching by upstream repository and review window; update one existing open umbrella instead of new issues per commit; dedupe repeated candidates preserving provenance and individual dispositions; daily observation may feed a weekly actionable batch; urgent actionable regressions bypass the delay; a closed umbrella is a completed epic and new changes start a new batch; prove dry-run parity, independently verify, then activate gradually with monitoring and rollback.
recommended: Approved: staged batching by upstream repository and review window; update one existing open umbrella instead of new issues per commit; dedupe repeated candidates preserving provenance and individual dispositions; daily observation may feed a weekly actionable batch; urgent actionable regressions bypass the delay; a closed umbrella is a completed epic and new changes start a new batch; prove dry-run parity, independently verify, then activate gradually with monitoring and rollback.
alternative: Retain the legacy deployed issue contract and use batch dry-run reports only.
unblocks: Batch rollout only; Steward closure authority remains a separate OPEN decision.
